note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Japanese, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-ja-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-ja). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-19: Japanese quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 口語訳 (japkougo) wording the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span: the whole passage, or the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, or exact OWB pieces joined with '……'. OWB's own inner quote marks become 『』 inside a quotation. `self_rendered` rows are places where Moody argues from the AV's very wording (born again / from above, 'washed', 'the Lord from heaven', the italic 'man', 'nail', the Revised Version's 'judgment'), a verse absent from OWB's critical text (Acts 8:37), and allusions or paraphrases in Moody's own voice, left as prose.
